name: Fix ChatEntry think section collapsible
description:
## Conversation Summary

1. **Issue Identified**: The collapsible component for displaying the "think" section in chat messages was empty and non-functional, preventing users from viewing the thinking process content.

2. **Solution Implemented**: Populated the think section Collapsible with a proper Document component to render the think content with appropriate title and brain icon.

3. **Component Structure**: Added Collapsible template slots (icon, title, and body) with the Document component configured to handle think content rendering and all associated events.

4. **User Experience**: Set the thinking section to be collapsed by default (`defaultOpen="false"`) while maintaining full functionality for expanding and viewing the content.

5. **Code Cleanup**: Removed the redundant thinking alert section that was previously placed below the main message content, consolidating the think display into a single, organized collapsible section.
